# PT Prodia Diagnostic Line Tbk

PT Prodia Diagnostic Line Tbk is a Medical and Diagnostic Laboratories company. PT Prodia Diagnostic Line is a company that specializes in clinical chemistry and reagents. They offer a range of products including controls/calibrators/standards, kit lines, instruments, hematology, immunoassay, snibe maglumi x3i, proline xi800 automatic chemiluminensce analyzer, and biomolecular. PT Prodia Diagnostic Line Tbk employs 22 people, founded in 2010. Headquartered in Bekasi, West Java, Indonesia, with presence in Australia and United States.

## About

Since its establishment in 2010, Proline has been manufacturing and supplying in vitro diagnostic products to more than 7.000 healthcare facilities in Indonesia. Striving to be Indonesia’s one stop solution IVD manufacturer, Proline key products range from clinical chemistry reagents, hematology reagents, immunology products, urinalysis system, lateral flow tests for drug test and infectious diseases as well as IVD instruments, with local content more than 40% for most products. Proline is ISO 13485:2016, GMPMD, GDPMD certified. Providing extensive support service for over 15 years of experience, Proline has become trusted medical device provider with expertise in IVD products.

properties.description: Since its establishment in 2010, Proline has been manufacturing and supplying in vitro diagnostic products to more than 7.000 healthcare facilities in Indonesia. Striving to be Indonesia’s one stop solution IVD manufacturer, Proline key products range from clinical chemistry reagents, hematology reagents, immunology products, urinalysis system, lateral flow tests for drug test and infectious diseases as well as IVD instruments, with local content more than 40% for most products. Proline is ISO 13485:2016, GMPMD, GDPMD certified. Providing extensive support service for over 15 years of experience, Proline has become trusted medical device provider with expertise in IVD products.
